title: Coinbase earnings: Wall Street divided on trading rebound after Robinhood crypto revenue sinks 55%
summary: Coinbase faces a key earnings test as analysts debate the strength of its trading rebound following a sharp drop in Robinhood's crypto revenue.

title: Crypto Long & Short: What happens when an AI agent pays for the wrong thing
summary: The largest card networks now sit in the top governance tier of x402, the standard that AI agents use to pay for things online. Albert Castellana of GenLayer Labs explains why that standard has no way to dispute a charge, and what happens when the payment settles but the agent receives something wrong or useless.

title: Wall Street backbone DTCC brings $30 trillion securities closer to blockchain with major banks
